Criterion: For receptacle installations, verify that the collected fluids within the pressure box are capable of being drained safely in ground and flight conditions. Standard: The receptacle installation has a pressure box below it that allows safe drainage of fluids, including fuel spray that may occur during aerial refueling. Safe drainage occurs during ground and flight conditions. Method of Compliance: Verification methods include analysis, test, demonstration, inspection and review of documentation. Analysis, ground demonstration, flight test and post-flight inspections verify fluids which collect within the pressure box are capable of being drained without causing hazards to the air vehicle, other aircraft, or personnel. References: JSSG-2009: 3.3.8, 4.3.8; F.3.4.6.2.2.3, F.4.4.6.2.2.3
